headline: GPU rental prices mostly flat this week; H200 up +2%, L40S down -1%, hyperscaler premiums remain wide.
bullets: H100 SXM has the widest hyperscaler premium at +166%: the hyperscaler median is $10.68 versus $4.02 for neoclouds, and Vast.ai is cheapest at $2.66.
MI300X is the best price-performance GPU at $2.64 per PFLOP-hour, with RunPod Community Cloud at $0.50 against a market index of $3.45.
H200's market index of $5.40 rose +2% over 7 days, and it carries a +124% hyperscaler premium ($10.30 versus $4.59 at neoclouds).
B200 leads the market at a $7.66 index with a +106% hyperscaler premium, and RunPod Community Cloud is cheapest at $5.98.
A100 80GB SXM has the lowest hyperscaler premium at +97% but the highest cost per compute at $8.65 per PFLOP-hour.
watch: Whether H200's +2% rise continues while L40S drifts lower after its -1% move.
